candidates.text: A six-person dev team in 30 seconds either saves startups or creates dependency hell at lightspeed. Either way I need to see it run.
Building strangers' ideas live in 10 minutes with zero interpretation allowed. Either brave or unhinged, but the demos will be honest.
The upgrade cycle in one sentence: newer number, same charger, wallet lighter.
Glyph lights are the phone equivalent of RGB: scientifically proven to add fps.
A 25,500mAh battery means the phone IS the power bank. Tank indeed.
Dynamic width inside f-strings is the trick I keep forgetting. This one sticks now.
Tutorial hell is real. Ugly real projects beat a 12-hour course every time.
Five free unlimited video tools sounds mythical until the render queue gets you. Solid roundup.
Google giving away the most powerful free AI tool feels like a glitch. Not complaining.
